purpose: Frozen inputs for the Phase 16B real-time Krylov decision experiment. This file is preregistration: it carries no results, costs, verdicts, or observed values, and is committed and gated before the producer runs.

target.note: The numeric value is shared; only h2_sto3g interprets it as chemical accuracy in Ha.

tfim4_crit.reference_override: The tfim builder's default |+...+> reference is overridden by this explicit computational-basis reference.

h2_sto3g.nuclear_repulsion_convention: included in the Hamiltonian identity term
h2_sto3g.declared_risk: Preregistered before execution: this reference is expected to have very small distinct-energy support, so a PASS here is weak chemistry evidence. The producer must report measured support; the design document Section 5 already requires this.

rt_hermitian.estimands: 2(m-1) real components of c plus 2m-1 of d = 4m-3

rt_unitary.phase_branch: midpoint of the declared enclosure; see grid_rule

rt_trotter.pencil: full Hermitian V^dag H V; the exact d(j-i) shortcut is forbidden because U_T need not commute with H
rt_trotter.step_rule: One fixed step U_T = trotter2_unitary(H_terms, dt, microsteps_per_dt); basis column k is U_T^k applied to the reference. Total times are never independently re-approximated.

acase_control.basis_construction: run_acase in exact arithmetic to the frozen size, then frozen
acase_control.pencil_rebuild: S_ij and H_ij are rebuilt from perturbed shared Pauli word expectations using bank.iter_operator_terms coefficients
acase_control.estimands: the bank word universe over the retained basis, bank.word_set(indices)

power_krylov_control.note: run_krylov_width.py's order argument counts powers after identity; size is order+1.

tfim4_crit.rule: pauli_orbit over the distinct Pauli words of the instance Hamiltonian

tfim4_para.rule: pauli_orbit over the distinct Pauli words of the instance Hamiltonian

tfim6_crit.rule: pauli_orbit over the distinct Pauli words of the instance Hamiltonian

growth.note: exact_ground_energy and target_error are null so no oracle stopping is used; growth runs to max_size.

grid_rule.enclosure_n4: exact extremal eigenvalues of the dense Hamiltonian
grid_rule.enclosure_n6: sum of absolute Pauli coefficients about the identity shift
grid_rule.strict_condition: (U - L) * dt < 2*pi, checked strictly; a violation is INVALID, not FAIL
grid_rule.secondary_sweep_role: diagnostic only; a multiplier whose strict condition fails is marked inadmissible

noise_model.description: Each independent positive-lag real/imaginary component receives Gaussian noise of standard deviation eps. Negative lags reuse conjugates, c(0)=1 stays exact, d(0) is real.
noise_model.paired_rule: rt_hermitian and rt_unitary consume the same c draw for a given (instance, cell, m, replica).
noise_model.seed_stream_rule: numpy SeedSequence([seed_root, instance_index, cell_index, m]) spawned per estimand family

cost_model.contract_note: Every basis is frozen by exact arithmetic before noise is applied. Adaptive construction and selection costs are therefore NOT priced, and the entire comparison is labelled fixed-basis estimation only, as the design document Section 4 permits.
cost_model.bounded_component_variance: Var(mean X) = (1-mu^2)/N <= 1/N for X in {-1,+1}; shots per component = ceil(1/eps^2) is sufficient under that bound, not a measured requirement.
cost_model.d_component_variance: bounded by Lambda^2/N with Lambda = sum_l |h_l| over the traceless part; shots = ceil(Lambda^2/eps_d^2)
cost_model.acase_word_variance: each Pauli word expectation on the reference is real and bounded in [-1,1], so it uses the same bounded-component bound as c
cost_model.allocation_rule: A total budget N_total is split equally across that arm's independent real components. eps for a bounded component is sqrt(n_components / N_total); eps_d for a Hamiltonian-weighted component is Lambda * sqrt(n_components / N_total).
cost_model.budget_grid_note: N_total = 10^d for each decade d listed.
cost_model.shots_to_target: the smallest TESTED budget whose median absolute error meets the target; no interpolation or extrapolation beyond this grid; censored when no tested budget qualifies
cost_model.excluded_note: Grouping is excluded for every arm alike, so the ratio is a component-count comparison under one bound, not a device-time comparison.

per_mode_floor.rule: absolute per-mode floor in the norm-normalized overlap spectrum via solve_projected(overlap_noise_floor=...)

decision_rule.qualifying_comparison: reaches the target AND has modeled shot ratio N_acase / N_rt >= 10, inclusive, on the tested budget grid
decision_rule.invalid_precedence: A failed deterministic check (independent pencil identity, strict phase-branch condition, reference/sector consistency, or missing provenance) gives INVALID for that instance, not NO-GO. Ordinary noisy solve failures remain in the statistics.

instance_status_order.condition: an exact-propagation real-time arm with a non-ridge regularizer has a qualifying comparison at c-component noise >= 1e-5
no PASS, but a qualifying comparison exists at c noise >= 1e-6, including a ridge-only comparison
neither above, and a required cost comparison is censored or unpriceable within the grid
otherwise; all comparisons complete but no qualifying candidate at c noise >= 1e-6

decision_rule.invalid_combination: If either required instance is INVALID the overall verdict is INVALID.
decision_rule.diagnostics_note: Diagnostic arms and instances are reported but cannot turn a failed primary comparison into GO.

prespecified_followup.permitted_on_no_go_or_conditional: exactly one estimator-variance refinement, replacing the flat bounded-component bound with the magnitude-dependent (1 - mu^2)/N using each component's own modeled magnitude
prespecified_followup.publication_rule: the primary verdict is published unchanged alongside any separately labelled refinement; thresholds are never moved after observing results
